title: A five-unit saving
hook: Two stated cases: explore the denominator in a relative saving.

knows: Reading the stated arithmetic assumptions and a small numerical chart
doesNotKnow: How the denominator in a relative saving affects the stated comparison

misconception: The headline alone determines Percent, regardless of the stated inputs.
objective: Compare the denominator in a relative saving in two explicit finite cases; separate model arithmetic from an empirical population claim.
keyState: Both question and changed cases computed; both parameter/result witnesses retained.

claims.text: A toy saving is 5 on a price of 15. What percentage of the original price is saved?
